turns.user: Find 10 published mixes with 28-day compressive strength of at least 40 MPa and a static yield stress between 1 and 4 kPa; prefer 3DCP studies.
turns.text:
I’ll check the database schema, then retrieve mixes with both reported 28-day strength and static yield stress. I’ll prioritize 3DCP studies and keep the paper and mix counts separate.
The literature search found exact measured matches in 3DCP papers. I’m checking the measurement records now so the final list reports observed values and flags any mixes with more than one yield-stress reading.
The broad SQL check hit the database’s time limit. I’ll retry on the ten candidate papers; the literature search has already returned their measured values.
The literature database returned **10 exact matches**, all from studies marked as 3DCP. The strength values are measured at 28 days; the static yield stresses are fresh-state measurements, not 28-day values.

| Published mix | 28-day strength (MPa) | Static yield stress (kPa) | Mix summary |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| [REF](https://doi.org/10.1007/s41062-024-01788-9) | 41.3 | 1.26 | Portland cement; w/b 0.43; s/b 2.00 |
| [3DPC mixture](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.addma.2023.103722) | 55.7 | 1.56 | Portland cement; w/b 0.35; s/b 1.00 |
| [Mixture A](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2017.12.112) | 49.7 | 3.35 | Cement, Class F fly ash, silica fume; w/b 0.14; s/b 0.50 |
| [TS-100](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2025.140392) | 77.6 | 1.46 | Cement, fly ash, silica fume; w/b 0.34; s/b 0.60 |
| [RFA-50](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2025.144187) | 44.6 | 1.76 | Cement and other powder; w/b 0.40; s/b 1.50 |
| [L0N100](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2026.145990) | 72.6 | 3.59 | Cement, silica fume, limestone powder; w/b 0.38; s/b 3.41 |
| [UP-X3P0.3](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2026.146928) | 66.0 | 1.56 | Calcium sulfoaluminate cement, silica fume, other powder; w/b 0.30; s/b 0.60 |
| [Ref](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cscm.2024.e02913) | 77.1 | 1.06 | Cement, fly ash, silica fume; w/b 0.25; s/b 1.50 |
| [HC-PCMs-30](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cscm.2025.e04688) | 48.1 | 3.56 | Cement, fly ash, calcium sulfoaluminate cement, silica fume; w/b 0.30; s/b 1.00 |
| [M20](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cscm.2026.e06188) | 50.7 | 1.18 | Cement and limestone powder; w/b 0.36; s/b 1.14 |

Here, **w/b** and **s/b** are water-to-binder and sand-to-binder mass ratios. These are extracted observations, not model predictions. Strength specimen types and fresh-state test protocols differ across papers, so check the linked methods before comparing values directly or reproducing a mix.

input.sql: SELECT p.doi, m.name_in_paper AS mix, p.is_3dcp_study, m.w_b_reported, m.sand_binder_ratio, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(x.value_canonical || ' MPa [' || COALESCE(t.comparability_group,'') || ']') FROM measurements x LEFT JOIN tests t ON t.test_uid=x.test_uid WHERE x.mix_uid=m.mix_uid AND x.quantity='compressive_strength' AND CAST(x.age_norm_d AS REAL)=28 AND CAST(x.value_canonical AS REAL)>=40) AS strength28, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(y.value_canonical || ' Pa [rest=' || COALESCE(y.rest_time_norm_s,'?') || ' s]') FROM measurements y WHERE y.mix_uid=m.mix_uid AND y.quantity='static_yield_stress' AND CAST(y.value_canonical AS REAL) BETWEEN 1000 AND 4000) AS yield_stress FROM mixes m JOIN papers p ON p.paper_uid=m.paper_uid WHERE p.is_3dcp_study='1' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurements x WHERE x.mix_uid=m.mix_uid AND x.quantity='compressive_strength' AND CAST(x.age_norm_d AS REAL)=28 AND CAST(x.value_canonical AS REAL)>=40) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurements y WHERE y.mix_uid=m.mix_uid AND y.quantity='static_yield_stress' AND CAST(y.value_canonical AS REAL) BETWEEN 1000 AND 4000) ORDER BY CAST(p.year AS INTEGER), p.doi, m.name_in_paper LIMIT 60
